scope: replacement forward-only Dataset Epoch only; legacy historical V2A source-selection and >=200-row model gate are unchanged
problem: The legacy collector selects CDD/Binance/OKX using ticker-derived symbols. A rotating future top-150 can contain ticker collisions, so historical load success is not sufficient evidence for the D0 exact-source registry.

rule.universe_identity_authority: the exact coin_id + symbol + name observed in the same immutable CoinGecko point-in-time universe archive
rule.CDD_historical_files: may remain an input to the legacy historical model but are not by themselves a prospective exact-identity authority
admission_conditions_all_required: The official provider public instrument metadata reports the exact constructed base/quote pair as live spot market data.
A current public coin-id-to-market identity bridge for the same observed CoinGecko coin_id identifies that exact provider and base/quote market; ticker match alone is forbidden.
The provider public OHLCV response contains physical non-sentinel rows with UTC timestamps and frozen QA invariants.
Raw universe identity bytes, provider instrument metadata, identity-bridge evidence and OHLCV bytes are preserved with SHA256.
Any ambiguity, duplicate identity, provider mismatch or bridge absence fails closed and falls through only to an already-preregistered materially distinct exact-source contract.
rule.rotating_universe_behavior: The rule is preregistered by class rather than by asset, so a future observed universe member may qualify prospectively in the same daily collection cycle without post-result source selection. The universe itself is not frozen until an actual D0 passes.
rule.no_silent_fallback: If neither preregistered native provider qualifies exact identity, only an already-preregistered alternate exact-source contract or an Option-B structural ineligibility adjudication may satisfy the eligible-universe source contract.
rule.provider_switch_within_epoch: forbidden after D0 unless separately preregistered as a future source eligibility/cutover event; D0 freezes the per-member source identity
rule.identity_collision_guard: A source whose ticker/pair exists but binds to a different coin identity is explicit SOURCE_IDENTITY_MISMATCH evidence, not a usable source.
